summary: Master Natural Language Processing for Analysts. Learn sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and LLM integration to unlock text-based insights. Enroll today.
lede: Natural language processing helps business, data, and research analysts turn unstructured text into transparent, defensible evidence. They learn to prepare text reproducibly, engineer features, build and evaluate classifiers, extract named entities, and interpret sentiment and topics using Python tools including pandas, scikit-learn, and spaCy. Exercises also address privacy, bias, data quality, and communicating findings and limitations to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for analysts who work with text data and need to translate language patterns into transparent, decision-ready evidence.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of data analysis, spreadsheets, and basic statistical concepts is recommended. Familiarity with Python syntax is helpful but advanced programming is not required. You should bring a laptop capable of running Jupyter Notebook or JupyterLab.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
